scope: PAM fixed-commit native multi-record data, source provenance and executable-entry admission; no algorithm execution.
allowed: Official GitHub repository metadata and raw files at pinned commit. Count actual downloaded bytes; at most one attempt per URL, curl timeout40s and individual max filesize bounded by remaining budget.
selection: Prefer already identified datasets/calls/train/netty.arff and all/netty.arff as native small files, not selected by outcomes. Inspect official tree for source mapping metadata and tests/main/import/POM dependencies. Do not fetch 15MB client_files archive. Optional small official source/example archive only if it can answer mapping gap within remaining budget.
checks: Raw bytes and git blob/SHA256 identities; format and record counts/duplicates without mining; available caller/source identifiers versus exact source spans/version and oracle; original main/input/output paths; local Java/Maven/JAR existence only.
forbidden: No installs/builds, algorithm/help/test runs, untrusted serialized loads, synthetic positives, Rust frontend changes, catalog/PROGRESS/shared-note edits.
stop: One bounded acquisition/read-only audit and one requested note. If native data is present but runnable task blocked, list exact blockers and stop. No expanding collection to manufacture positive evidence.
outputs: This independent run plus research/notes/2026-11-18-pam-multirecord-admission.md. Authored files via apply_patch; raw downloads unmodified.
